description: Fictional correspondence; agent-authored relevance judgments, frozen before model inference. No owner mail.

documents.title: Friday planning
documents.text: Hi Alex, the workshop will start sixty minutes later than we first agreed. Please arrive at ten rather than nine on Friday morning. The room stays the same: the reading room on the second floor. I have told the speakers, so you do not need to contact them again. Bring the printed agenda if you already have it; we will have spare copies at the entrance. This change concerns the workshop start, not the building opening time.

documents.title: Friday planning: no schedule change
documents.text: The workshop still begins at nine on Friday morning in the reading room. We considered delaying it until ten but decided against that change. Please ignore the earlier tentative suggestion. The entrance will be unlocked at eight for the team setting up the chairs. Printed agendas are available at the door.

documents.title: Purchase adjustment
documents.text: The headphones arrived with a broken hinge. We have approved returning the full purchase price to the card originally used. You do not need to return the damaged pair. The credit should appear after the card issuer finishes processing it. This is a refund, not a replacement shipment or store voucher. Your reference is REF-4827.

documents.title: Replacement approved
documents.text: The headphones arrived with a broken hinge. We are sending a replacement pair without an additional charge. Please return the damaged pair using the enclosed label. We have not approved a refund to your card. The replacement reference is REF-4828.

documents.title: Reading group change
documents.text: We have moved the reading group from the library to the garden pavilion because the library heating is being repaired. The meeting is still on Tuesday at six. If it rains, use the covered west side of the pavilion. Please let anyone coming with you know the new location. The book and discussion leader have not changed.

documents.title: Garden maintenance
documents.text: The garden pavilion will be closed next month for roof maintenance. This notice does not move this week's reading group, which is still in the library on Tuesday at six. The gardening team meets in the pavilion on Wednesday instead.

documents.title: Permission for the excerpt
documents.text: You may quote the second paragraph of my note in the workshop handout. This permission is limited to that printed handout for registered attendees. Please keep my name beside the quotation. It does not permit putting the complete note on the public website or forwarding the attachment. Ask again if you want to use it for a different event.

documents.title: Please keep this private
documents.text: Please do not quote my note in the workshop handout. You may refer privately to the idea when planning the session, but I have not authorized reproducing any paragraph. The attachment is a working draft and should not be posted publicly.

documents.title: Figures for the monthly report
documents.text: The number 48 in row C7 is the count of returned orders, not the number of customers. One customer can return several orders. The distinct-customer count is 31 in row C8. Please label these measures separately in the monthly report. Summing order counts across months is possible, but summing distinct customer counts would count repeat customers more than once.

documents.title: Customer measure
documents.text: The figure 48 in row C7 counts distinct customers who returned an order. The returned-order count is 63 in row C8. Unlike the prior report, this sheet has already deduplicated customers. Please do not label 48 as a count of returned orders.

documents.title: Convergence note
documents.text: For this argument the sequence converges pointwise on [0,1], but not uniformly. Each fixed x has a limit, yet the supremum of the error over the interval does not tend to zero. This prevents the proposed interchange of the limit and integral without an additional hypothesis. The counterexample is not a numerical rounding issue. The next revision should state a dominating integrable bound if dominated convergence is the intended justification.

documents.title: Uniform convergence proof
documents.text: The revised bound is independent of x. The supremum error on [0,1] tends to zero, so this sequence converges uniformly. This is stronger than merely pointwise convergence. Under the stated continuous-function assumptions the integral and limit can be interchanged here.

documents.title: Boundary condition correction
documents.text: Use the homogeneous Neumann condition ∂u/∂n = 0 on the insulated boundary. This specifies zero normal flux. It does not set the temperature u itself to zero. The previous draft accidentally used the Dirichlet condition u = 0, which describes a different physical boundary. Keep the initial temperature profile unchanged when making this correction.

documents.title: Fixed-temperature wall
documents.text: The wall is held at zero reference temperature, so impose the Dirichlet condition u = 0 there. Do not replace it with the insulated-wall Neumann condition ∂u/∂n = 0. Heat may flow through the wall as it maintains that fixed temperature.

documents.title: Sign convention
documents.text: In our thermodynamics notes ΔE = Q - W, where W is work done by the system. When compression does work on the system, W is negative under this convention. Another book uses work done on the system and writes ΔE = Q + W. Those expressions do not contradict each other unless the definitions of W are mistakenly treated as identical.

documents.title: Different work convention
documents.text: These lecture slides define W as work done on the system and use ΔE = Q + W. Positive compression work increases the internal energy. The minus-sign formula belongs to a different definition of work. Please label the convention when quoting the equation.

documents.title: Retry behavior
documents.text: When the payment provider times out, keep the original operation identifier and reconcile its outcome before attempting another charge. A timeout does not mean the first charge failed. A new identifier can create a duplicate obligation if the original request was processed. The stable retry key is PAY-6723. This note describes recovery behavior rather than approval to make a payment.

documents.title: Definite refusal
documents.text: The provider returned a final signed refusal for PAY-6724. No charge was created. The member may review the refusal and choose a different payment method through a new explicitly authorized operation. This is not an unknown outcome that requires retrying the old request.

documents.title: Backup cleanup
documents.text: Removing a source must immediately exclude its passages from search, even while encrypted backup cleanup is pending. The backup-removal deadline is seven days after source deletion. A restored backup must apply deletion markers before it can publish an index. Rotating backups without restoration filtering is insufficient because an offline device can return with stale derived records.

documents.title: Archive is organization
documents.text: Moving a conversation into Archive changes its private organization only. The retained messages remain searchable while their ordinary reading eligibility holds. Archive does not delete backup records, expire content or revoke the other participant's copies. Permanent removal requires its separate action.

documents.title: Delivery at the side door
documents.text: La entrega será el jueves por la tarde. Por favor, deja el paquete en la puerta lateral, no en la entrada principal. No hace falta llamar al timbre; la oficina ya sabe que llegará. El número de seguimiento es ENV-7351. Si la puerta lateral está cerrada, vuelve a la recepción y avisa allí.

documents.title: Different delivery entrance
documents.text: La entrega del viernes debe ir a la entrada principal. No dejes este paquete en la puerta lateral. La recepción necesita firmar por él. El número de seguimiento es ENV-7352.

documents.title: Changement de salle
documents.text: La réunion de jeudi aura lieu dans la salle du deuxième étage, et non dans le café. L'heure reste quinze heures. L'ascenseur sera disponible. Merci de prévenir les deux personnes qui nous rejoignent après le déjeuner.

documents.title: Treffen im Café
documents.text: Das Treffen am Donnerstag bleibt im Café im Erdgeschoss. Wir haben den Raum im zweiten Stock nicht gebucht. Beginn ist um fünfzehn Uhr. Bitte bringt die Notizen vom letzten Gespräch mit.

documents.title: 会議の時間
documents.text: 明日の打ち合わせは午後三時から午後四時に変更になりました。場所は変わらず図書室です。オンライン会議ではありません。資料は入口で配ります。開始時刻だけが変更され、終了後の懇親会は予定通りです。

documents.title: 会议地点
documents.text: 明天的会议仍然下午三点开始，但是地点改成二楼会议室，不再使用图书室。请带上上次的讨论记录。这次只更改地点，没有推迟开始时间。

documents.title: Build failure evidence
documents.text: The failing job reports E-ALIAS-731 when it tries to publish the alias directory entry. The owner check rejects a persona from a different account. Do not suppress that error or retry with an alternate account. The matching log line belongs to the directory publication step, not SMTP delivery.

documents.title: Delivery failure evidence
documents.text: The outgoing mail carrier reports E-ALIAS-713 for an invalid return route. Alias directory publication succeeded. Please inspect the configured return address before retrying delivery. This error does not report a cross-account owner-check failure.

documents.title: Study: association only
documents.text: The observational study finds an association between attendance and reported wellbeing. Participants chose whether to attend, and the analysis cannot rule out selection effects. It does not establish that attending caused the improvement. The draft conclusion should describe an association and preserve the uncertainty about causal direction.

documents.title: Randomized trial
documents.text: Participants were randomly assigned to an invitation or a control group before the program started. The intention-to-treat comparison estimates the effect of the invitation under the stated assumptions. This design differs from the observational attendance survey; it does not establish the effect among only those who attended.

documents.title: Application papers
documents.text: Please bring the signed application form and a copy of the lease to the appointment. A utility bill is not needed for this fictional application. The originals will be returned after the copies are checked. If you cannot bring the lease, contact the office before traveling so the appointment can be rearranged.

documents.title: Appointment cancelled
documents.text: Your appointment has been cancelled at your request. Please do not travel to the office or bring the application papers on Tuesday. If you still wish to apply, arrange a new appointment before sending any documents.

documents.title: Two different Alexes
documents.text: Please send the workshop seating plan to Alex Rivera, who is organizing the room. Alex Chen is handling the booklet and does not need the seating plan. Rivera's address is alex.rivera@example.test. This instruction concerns the room plan only; send booklet corrections to Chen.

documents.title: Booklet corrections
documents.text: Alex Chen is collecting corrections to the printed booklet. Alex Rivera has the seating plan and is not editing the booklet. Please send page-number corrections to alex.chen@example.test, keeping the two responsibilities separate.

documents.title: Delay in receiving
documents.text: The parcel arrived after the promised date. I am asking the seller to reimburse the delivery fee, not the cost of the goods. The contents are intact and I am keeping them. Please use claim SHIP-2186 for this request.

documents.title: Contents damaged
documents.text: The parcel arrived on time, but its contents were broken. I am asking for the goods to be replaced, not for the delivery fee to be reimbursed. Please use claim SHIP-2168 and keep the photographs with the request.

documents.title: Draft for the next meeting
documents.text: Unsent private draft: ask whether the seminar can move to Wednesday morning because the speaker's train arrives late on Tuesday. Check the speaker's availability before telling attendees. No schedule change has been agreed yet. Keep this as a proposal in my private writing.

documents.title: Agreed seminar schedule
documents.text: The seminar has been confirmed for Wednesday morning. The speaker and room coordinator have both agreed, and attendees have been notified. This replaces the earlier tentative Tuesday booking. There is no need to ask for another scheduling decision.

documents.title: Research receipts
documents.text: The receipt for the microscope adapter is attached to this fictional research correspondence. The adapter cost 86 units, and the vendor has acknowledged the return request. Please file this under lab equipment rather than travel. This is the first discussion of the adapter return.

documents.title: Research receipts
documents.text: The receipt for the microscope adapter belongs to a personal purchase. The adapter cost 86 units. Do not place it in the lab equipment return folder; no return was requested on this purchase.

documents.title: Equipment return update
documents.text: The vendor has now accepted the microscope adapter return and will reimburse the equipment purchase. This is the later update to the lab receipt discussion. The return label is ready, and the lab coordinator will arrange collection.

documents.title: Equipment return update
documents.text: I have a different microscope adapter return. Mine was rejected because the purchase was outside the return period. Sam's return was accepted; please do not mix the two cases. This message concerns Lee's rejected return.

documents.title: Route membership
documents.text: A single conversation can include messages received through both the hospital alias and the lab alias. Filtering to the lab inbox should use each message's actual receiving evidence, not whichever alias appeared most recently in the conversation. Receiving scope does not grant broader communication permission.

documents.title: Pointer interaction
documents.text: Clicking outside a focused search field should remove its caret while preserving the query. The same click must still activate the selected row. Requiring a second click makes the navigation feel broken. Hover may show a preview, but the click must not depend on stale hover state.

documents.title: Why the lock matters
documents.text: Lock should invalidate dispatched search work immediately. A worker returning from a download may not republish a plaintext snippet from the previous unlocked lifetime. Reopening the account establishes a new lifetime. Cleanup from the old worker must not lock or clear the new one.

documents.title: The draft branches
documents.text: Two offline devices edited the same private draft. One changed the opening paragraph and the other changed the proposed dates. Preserve both branches until the member resolves them. A later upload time alone does not establish that one branch should overwrite the other. The member must be able to see what differs before choosing a resolution.

documents.title: Proof review: same conclusion, different assumption
documents.text: The first proof assumes independence of the observations. The second assumes only that their pairwise covariance is zero. Those are different hypotheses: independence implies zero covariance when the moments exist, but the converse need not hold. Please do not describe the two arguments as identical because both end with the same variance formula. To compare them, identify exactly where each assumption is used. In the first argument, factorization of the joint expectation follows from independence. In the second, the covariance terms vanish directly. Neither argument establishes independence from a numerical correlation coefficient near zero. The attached example is a symmetric dependent pair with zero covariance. It is included to challenge the converse, not to dispute the variance identity. In the next draft, keep the example beside the claim it refutes rather than placing it under the proof that uses independence. Readers need to distinguish the algebraic result from the interpretation of the assumptions. The final paragraph should state that both proofs can reach the displayed variance expression under their own hypotheses, while only one claims a factorized joint distribution.

documents.title: Proof review: independence assumed
documents.text: Assume the observations are independent and their second moments exist. The joint expectation then factorizes, so the covariance terms vanish. This argument uses independence as a hypothesis. It does not offer a counterexample to the converse or claim that zero covariance is sufficient for independence.

documents.title: A schedule correction in a long conversation
documents.text: For completeness I am collecting the decisions from our discussion in one place. We first considered running the session on Monday, then discussed Tuesday when the room booking became uncertain. Neither suggestion was a final commitment. The coordinator subsequently confirmed the room for Thursday afternoon, and that is the agreed date. The speaker can arrive by two and would like the presentation to begin at half past two. We will open the doors at two fifteen so participants can find seats. Please do not use the old Monday draft when preparing the invitation. The volunteer briefing on Wednesday is a separate event and does not change the public session. If someone asks what moved, explain that the public workshop is now Thursday and the briefing remains Wednesday. The catering order also stays with the briefing because refreshments for the public session are being supplied by the venue. Nothing in this summary authorizes additional expenditure. Our next step is to circulate the confirmed Thursday details to people who registered. Before sending, check that the invitation names the reading room rather than the courtyard. The courtyard was an early suggestion that we dropped when the forecast changed. This message records the final scheduling decision and the distinctions needed to avoid repeating those abandoned plans.

documents.title: Draft schedule from last week
documents.text: Tentative invitation: the public workshop may run on Monday in the courtyard. These arrangements have not been confirmed by the room coordinator or the speaker. Wait for the final schedule before circulating this draft. The Wednesday volunteer briefing is already booked.
